title: Adjoint Matching: Fine-tuning Flow and Diffusion Generative Models with Memoryless Stochastic Optimal Control
tldr_zh: reward 微调必须用 memoryless 噪声调度 σ(t)=√(2η_t) 消除初值偏差；Adjoint Matching 是无 importance weighting 的最小二乘 SOC 回归
tldr_en: Memoryless noise schedule σ(t)=√(2η_t) is necessary for unbiased reward fine-tuning; Adjoint Matching solves SOC via least-squares regression without importance weighting

key_numbers.context: memoryless noise schedule，唯一能消除初值 value-function 偏差的噪声调度

key_numbers.number: σ(t) → ∞ at t=0, σ(t) → 0 at t=1
key_numbers.context: memoryless schedule 的端点行为，由 α₀=β₁=0, α₁=β₀=1 约束导出
Adjoint Matching 目标的唯一临界点是最优控制 u*
当 σ(t)=0 时，naive KL 正则化微调完全无效，因为 X₀ 完全决定 X₁
